independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG4 scope. Their round-2 re-baselines were made by KBE-R6 and FE-R5; I judged them here, I did not author them. summary:
PASS, no new findings. The round-2 repairs hold as acceptance behaviour.
F-DG4-122: the value gap is a percentage ('100 %', never money) on T10, the Executive Overview and the Finance dashboard, in EN and AR.
F-DG4-123: the value headlines are on the profit-and-cash basis (90), with top line (300) and non-cash (45) beside them, labelled and never summed, on all four surfaces. p4-value-headlines test 2 ran and passed in both projects.
My own probes:
• each basis drills to records whose decimal sum equals it; the gross line now drills and sums exactly;
• a non-trivial gap of 0.666667 ignores the top line;
• scoping refuses outsiders with 404; malformed narrowing is refused;
• a missing amount is Unknown, never 0 or green; the Q1 filter changes all three bases.
The two re-baselined QA tests and p4-dashboards 4b still assert their clauses literally.
Results: static green; unit green on Node 22 and 24 in both locale settings; integration 1960/1960 twice, with 61 migrations, 652 operations and every pending list empty; tests/qa 172/172; REQ-DLV-036 85/85 plus the A04/A08-A09 e2e; the 137-row trace clean; validators all PASS.
e2e: every non-pass is a disclosed 30 s load timeout of the DG2 journey 'Define → G2', which is 24/24 when run alone in each locale, or interference between my own two overlapping runs. All of them are explained in RUN-NOTES.md and the check actuals.
